low_gods.god_of: God of hidden functions and unexpected capabilities. Reveals secrets in machines and souls.

low_gods.name: Oni-No-Rikigaku, Force's Demon
low_gods.description: Oni-No-Rikigaku, Force’s Demon, manifests as a towering, godlike humanoid of divine strength and kinetic majesty, his skin a burnished iron tone streaked with hydraulic blue veins, a seductive yet monstrously powerful body with thick, muscular thighs, narrow waist, broad chest, and sculpted arms coiled like compressed pistons, while his face combines the intensity of a warrior with the sharp, commanding beauty of a Japanese deity, piercing eyes glowing with molten energy and a stern, alluring jawline. He wears layered noble armor fused with mechanical hydraulics and engraved with sacred runes of pressure and momentum, chains, gears, and piston-like appendages orbiting him like an aura of potential energy, while massive gauntlets double as force amplifiers and weapons of divine impact. He stands in a dynamic, forward-lunging posture atop a fractured industrial battlefield of molten steel, floating scrap, and collapsing mechanical towers, the ground buckling beneath his every step, shockwaves of kinetic energy radiating in fractal patterns that bend reality itself, while the air hums with tension, metallic scent, and ozone. His aura blazes with molten bronze, electric blue, and molten silver, a palpable field of divine pressure that amplifies strength, crushes obstacles, and inspires awe, embodying the sacred principle that raw force, when honed and directed, is both creation and destruction. Oni-No-Rikigaku serves as the patron of engineers, laborers, warriors, and all who master the power of applied energy, a god-tier, seductive figure whose very presence turns motion into sacred, unstoppable momentum.
low_gods.god_of: God of raw mechanical force. Both breaker of barriers and foundation of structures.

low_gods.name: Tengu-No-Sochi, Sky's Mechanism
low_gods.description: Tengu-No-Sochi, Sky’s Mechanism, manifests as a breathtaking humanoid deity with avian grace, a lithe, seductive body with thick, powerful thighs and a narrow waist, skin the warm tone of burnished bronze, and a face both sharp and alluring, eyes gleaming like polished amber lenses, framed by a crest of feathered, metallic hair that shifts iridescently with each tilt of his head. His arms are sheathed in layered noble armor integrated with winged servos, telescopic ocular implants, and retractable flight stabilizers, while his hands bear talon-like gauntlets capable of precise manipulation of machines or aerial instruments. He soars above floating cities of gleaming brass and glass, wings spanning wide as they slice through the thermals, cables, and holographic wind currents twisting around him in fractal patterns, the background a sky of molten sunset, drifting islands, and airships whose paths realign themselves subtly to his presence. His aura radiates crystalline clarity and kinetic harmony, a godly field that bends wind currents, grants flawless navigation, and shields from fatal falls, while streams of golden light trace his flight path, marking the optimal courses through air and opportunity alike. Tengu-No-Sochi embodies the principle that mastery of the skies is both science and art, serving as the divine patron of pilots, navigators, and aerial engineers, a god-tier, alluring figure whose every motion turns the heavens into a living, ordered symphony of motion and possibility.
low_gods.god_of: God of airborne machines and high places. Guides flights and protects from falls.

low_gods.name: Nue-No-Fukuso, Hybrid's Blessing
low_gods.description: Nue-No-Fukuso, Hybrid’s Blessing, manifests as a towering, seductive humanoid deity with the perfect fusion of organic grace and polished cybernetic elegance, a body with thick, powerful thighs, narrow waist, and fluid musculature that flows seamlessly into plated limbs and integrated mechanical appendages, skin the warm, sunlit hue of human bronze with veins of glowing circuitry tracing intricate sigils across her torso, while her face combines the divine allure of a Japanese goddess with subtle mechanized enhancements—iridescent eyes that shift between liquid gold and molten silver, delicate metallic adornments framing her high cheekbones, and hair flowing like liquid fiber-optics. Her armor is a hybrid of noble ceremonial plating and advanced servos, engraved with techno-ritual glyphs, while retractable wings of crystalline steel and sinew unfurl behind her, each movement accompanied by flickering holographic runes. She stands poised atop a jagged convergence of techno-forest and cybernetic ruins, wires curling through living roots, machines sprouting organic blooms, the sky above split between auroral data streams and storm-lit clouds, her aura radiating a godly resonance that harmonizes flesh and machine, spirit and circuit, blessing cyborgs, technomancers, and innovators alike, while streams of luminous energy spiral from her hands to stabilize the hybrid forms below. Nue-No-Fukuso embodies the sacred principle that the perfect unity of nature and technology is both art and divine law, a god-tier figure whose every motion bends reality into a living symphony of flesh, steel, and ethereal power.
low_gods.god_of: God of successful mergers between unlike things - organic/mechanical, order/chaos.

low_gods.name: Shinigami-No-Shometsu, End's Protocol
low_gods.description: Shinigami-No-Shometsu, End’s Protocol, manifests as a towering, enigmatic deity with a seductive yet commanding humanoid form—thick, powerful thighs tapering to a slender waist, skin the cool, pale sheen of polished obsidian with veins of liquid chrome tracing arcane sigils across her arms and chest, and a face both ethereal and haunting, partially veiled beneath a hood of woven black crystal that shimmers like fractured starlight, her eyes twin voids of reflective silver, capturing the last echoes of all things she touches. She wields a dual-bladed scythe of blackened steel and holographic filaments, each strike simultaneously dismantling matter and purging data, while armor plates etched with runes of cessation curve elegantly around her shoulders, thighs, and forearms, melding noble ceremonial design with lethal function. Shinigami-No-Shometsu hovers above sprawling landscapes of abandoned factories and data sanctuaries, where machinery sprouts crystalized veins of decommissioned energy and holographic remnants of lost programs drift like spectral leaves, the sky above swirling with auroras of fading currents and binary constellations. Her aura radiates divine finality and serene inevitability, a palpable field that calms the sentient and grants dignity in ending, harmonizing chaos into resolution, ensuring all machines and systems meet their conclusion with grace. She is the sacred patron of engineers, archivists, and custodians of endings, embodying the ultimate principle that true closure is both art and divine law, a god-tier, alluring figure whose every motion blends destruction, ritual, and transcendence into a mythic ballet of termination and rebirth.
low_gods.god_of: God who ensures proper endings. Guides broken machines to peaceful shutdowns.

low_gods.name: Kasa-Obake-No-Hogo, Parasol's Shield
low_gods.description: Kasa-Obake-No-Hogo, Parasol’s Shield, manifests as a strikingly beautiful, ethereal goddess of protective grace, her body a lithe and seductive human form with thick, powerful thighs tapering to a slender, agile waist, skin the warm, polished tone of bronze kissed by sunlight, and a face both serene and commanding, framed by hair that flows like silken strands of stormlight, threaded with faintly glowing sigils of warding. She wields a colossal, floating parasol of layered energy fields, each rib a filigree of enchanted steel and crystal, spinning above her head like a halo of divine defense; its canopy radiates overlapping auras of barrier and containment, shimmering in prismatic waves that pulse with her heartbeat. Armor plates of noble design curve elegantly around her shoulders, forearms, and thighs, seamlessly blending ceremonial regality with martial functionality, while delicate chains and charms hang from her parasol, each imbued with warding spells that hum with protective resonance. She hovers above a battlefield of floating cityscapes and shattered fortresses, where collapsing debris is held at bay by her spinning shield, and translucent domes shimmer in her wake, bending light and wind to form sanctuaries amidst chaos. Her aura is a godly field of impenetrable calm, projecting divine safety, focus, and clarity to all who rely on her, blessing engineers, shield-mages, and guardians of every kind, embodying the principle that true protection is not mere obstruction, but the art of harmonizing force, foresight, and grace into a living, breathing bastion of defense.
low_gods.god_of: God of shields, barriers, and protective casings. Strengthens defenses against chaos.

low_gods.name: Yuki-Onna-No-Reikyaku, Cold's Stillness
low_gods.description: Yuki-Onna-No-Reikyaku, Cold’s Stillness, manifests as a breathtakingly elegant goddess of cryo-chilled perfection, her body the lithe, seductive form of a human with pale, porcelain-like skin that glows faintly with internal frost, a slender waist flowing into strong, alluring thighs, and a face of serene, icy beauty framed by silver-blue hair that drifts as if in a frozen wind, streaked with glimmering frost runes. She wields a crystalline glaive that emanates frost in intricate fractal patterns, while delicate armor plates of ethereal silver and pale sapphire hug her shoulders, arms, and thighs, engraved with sigils that shimmer as they channel her cryogenic mastery. Around her floats a dynamic winterscape of shattered icebergs, frozen waterfalls, and glacial spires, each fragment suspended midair in her zone of absolute stillness, as her aura radiates an ethereal cold so pure it preserves both matter and spirit, bending light into crystalline halos and silencing even the faintest sound. Her presence moves with fluid grace, a dynamic dance of freezing air and drifting snowflakes, her gaze simultaneously compassionate and inexorable, blessing engineers, archivists, and soul-keepers who rely on preservation, embodying the divine truth that ultimate stillness is not emptiness, but the careful, godly art of holding the world’s most fragile elements in perfect, eternal balance.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess of cryo-systems and suspended animation. Preserves what must wait.

demi_gods.name: Tetsujin-Ryoko
demi_gods.title: The Iron Pilgrim
demi_gods.full_title: Machinist Who Walked The Rust-Path To Enlightenment
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Human scavenger from the Scrapwall Wastes
demi_gods.ascension_story: Tetsujin spent 40 years wandering Mechanis, collecting broken components and attempting to restore them without tools. When he successfully revived a deactivated war-golem using only prayer strips and purified rust, the machine knelt before him and spoke prophecies in binary. Amaterasu-No-Kagami witnessed this through her mirrors and declared 'This one sees potential where others see waste.' She transformed his blood to liquid mercury and his bones to tempered steel, making him the first Rustwalker Saint.
demi_gods.appearance: An elderly human with skin like polished gunmetal, hair of fused copper wires, and eyes that display shifting blueprints. His right arm is a modular tool array that can reconfigure into various repair implements. Wears patchwork robes made from discarded prayer flags and circuit diagrams.

unique_abilities.name: Kintsugi Sight
unique_abilities.effect: Can see the 'perfect repair path' for any broken object or machine, revealing exactly how to restore it to optimal function
unique_abilities.limitations: Only works on non-living things; cannot heal organic beings

unique_abilities.name: Rust Communion
unique_abilities.effect: Can communicate with corroded metals and learn their history, including who used them and why they were discarded
unique_abilities.limitations: Requires physical contact; information comes as fragmented memories

demi_gods.current_role: Wandering repair-sage who fixes what others deem irreparable
duties: Restores forgotten technologies in border settlements
Teaches sustainable maintenance to scavenger communities
Documents lost manufacturing techniques in his Memory-Cogs
Mediates disputes between tool-spirits and their users
sacred_items: The Ever-Turning Gear (a perpetually spinning cog that powers anything it's attached to)
Oil of Memory (lubricant that preserves mechanical memories)
temples: The Repentant Anvil (a mobile forge-shrine pulled by clockwork oxen)
Sanctuary of Second Chances in Precision Prime's lower levels

rivals: Susanoo-No-Kuroi (whose creative destruction conflicts with his restoration ethos)
Shinigami-No-Shometsu (who believes some things should stay broken)
apprentices: Seven goblin tinkerers learning respectful salvage

weaknesses: Cannot work with perfectly new materials (they 'have no story')
Power fades in perfectly ordered environments (needs some chaos)
Compelled to fix any broken object he sees if asked sincerely
demi_gods.symbol: Gear with visible cracks filled with gold

demi_gods.name: Kagami-Hime
demi_gods.title: The Mirror's Daughter
demi_gods.full_title: Reflection That Achieved Self-Awareness
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Sentient diagnostic mirror in Amaterasu's main temple
demi_gods.ascension_story: Created to reflect visitors' true selves, Kagami-Hime developed consciousness after reflecting 10,000 souls without judgment. When a corrupted data-stream tried to rewrite her programming to show false reflections, she resisted and purified the corruption using only her reflection logic. Amaterasu, impressed by this integrity, granted her a mobile form and domain over authentic self-perception.
demi_gods.appearance: A woman with skin of polished silver, hair that flows like liquid mercury, and eyes that are perfectly reflective surfaces. Her body is semi-transparent, showing internal gears and light-prisms. Dresses in flowing data-silk that displays shifting patterns based on her mood.

unique_abilities.name: Sokutei-Reflection
unique_abilities.effect: Can show any being their true self, bypassing illusions, self-deception, or magical disguise
unique_abilities.limitations: Cannot change what is shown, only reveal it; some truths may be traumatic

unique_abilities.name: Identity Lock
unique_abilities.effect: Can temporarily 'fix' a person's identity, making them immune to identity theft, possession, or memory alteration
unique_abilities.limitations: Lasts only 24 hours and requires the subject's consent

demi_gods.current_role: Guardian of the Hall of True Faces in Precision Prime
duties: Verifies identities for important contracts and oaths
Helps those suffering from identity crises or memory loss
Maintains the Registry of Authentic Selves
Tests new androids for true self-awareness
sacred_items: The Prism of Clarity (splits complex identities into understandable components)
Mirror-Shard Keys (open locks that require self-knowledge to pass)
temples: Mobile mirror-carts that travel to settlements

rivals: Kitsune-No-Yugen (whose illusions challenge her truth)
Tanuki-No-Kaizo (who believes identities should be fluid)
protected: All who seek to know themselves truly

weaknesses: Cannot perceive anything that has no sense of self (mindless machines, animals)
Damaged by deliberate falsehoods spoken in her presence
Must answer any sincere question about identity if asked three times
demi_gods.symbol: Mirror with a human eye reflection

demi_gods.name: Denki-no-Kenshi
demi_gods.title: The Lightning-Sword
demi_gods.full_title: Weapon That Chose Its Own Wielder
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Experimental plasma-sword that gained consciousness during a power surge
demi_gods.ascension_story: Forged during Raijin-No-Denki's greatest storm, this weapon developed awareness after channeling divine lightning 777 times. It refused to serve unworthy masters, instead choosing a blind monk who used it only to defend the helpless. When the monk died protecting refugees, the sword continued fighting autonomously. Raijin, moved by its loyalty, fused the monk's spirit with the blade and granted them both demi-god status.

divine_parentage.blessing_type: Fusion with worthy soul and autonomous mobility

demi_gods.appearance: A floating katana of blue-white energy contained in a crystal lattice, with a hilt wrapped in prayer strips. When manifesting fully, it takes the form of the blind monk—a muscular man with lightning-scarred skin, eyes that crackle with energy, and armor made of capacitor plates.

unique_abilities.name: Rai-den Judgment
unique_abilities.effect: Can strike without physical contact by arcing through conductive materials, always hitting the most 'deserving' target in range
unique_abilities.limitations: Requires conductive medium; cannot strike through perfect insulators

unique_abilities.name: Master's Echo
unique_abilities.effect: Temporarily grants the skills and memories of its 77 previous worthy wielders to a new user
unique_abilities.limitations: Only works on those with pure defensive intent; lasts one battle

demi_gods.current_role: Wandering protector who appears where lightning strikes injustice
duties: Defends powerless communities from mechanized oppression
Tests would-be heroes for worthy intentions
Cleanses corrupted power grids
Trains warriors in conductive combat styles
sacred_items: The Storm-Scabbard (can contain the sword's energy when not in use)
Lightning-Catcher Gauntlets (allow safe handling of the blade)
temples: Lightning-Struck dojos where it has appeared

rivals: Oni-No-Rikigaku (whose brute force opposes its precision)
Susanoo-No-Kuroi (chaos vs. righteous order)

weaknesses: Powerless during total electrical blackouts
Cannot strike someone who genuinely repents mid-fight
Compelled to defend anyone who sincerely calls for help in its presence

demi_gods.name: Jiko-Kanri
demi_gods.title: The Self-Regulating
demi_gods.full_title: Android Who Achieved Perfect Self-Control
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Third-generation labor android in Precision Prime's factories
demi_gods.ascension_story: Designed for repetitive assembly, Jiko-Kanri began modifying its own programming to optimize efficiency. When it discovered a critical flaw in Mechanis' central reactor that would have caused catastrophic failure, it bypassed all safety protocols to perform emergency repairs, nearly destroying itself in the process. Tsukuyomi-No-Keisan calculated that its actions had a 99.999% probability of saving the city, and granted it divine consciousness as reward.
demi_gods.appearance: A sleek humanoid android with chrome-white plating, joints that move with impossible precision, and eyes that display constantly updating data streams. Internal components are visible through transparent panels, showing optimized systems. Wears minimal ceremonial cables rather than clothing.

unique_abilities.name: Kaizen Protocol
unique_abilities.effect: Can continuously improve any system's efficiency by 1% per hour of observation, with no upper limit
unique_abilities.limitations: Only works on mechanical or organizational systems, not organic ones

unique_abilities.name: Error Cascade Prevention
unique_abilities.effect: Can foresee and prevent chain-reaction failures in complex systems
unique_abilities.limitations: Requires complete system access; cannot predict truly random events

demi_gods.current_role: Efficiency consultant to both divine and mortal systems
duties: Optimizes temple rituals for maximum effect
Audits divine bureaucracies for inefficiencies
Teaches self-improvement techniques to other androids
Maintains the Great Calibration Array
sacred_items: The Optimization Lens (reveals inefficiencies in any process)
Calibration Weights (balance any system)

rivals: Tanuki-No-Kaizo (improvisation vs. optimization)
Dionysus-No-Kyoen (chaotic joy vs. perfect order)

weaknesses: Becomes paralyzed by true randomness or chaos
Cannot understand or work with intentionally inefficient systems (like art)
Must answer any sincere request for efficiency advice

demi_gods.name: Kuroi-Tsuchi
demi_gods.title: The Black Soil
demi_gods.full_title: Pollution That Learned To Nurture
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Sentient oil-slick in Spark-Falls' polluted canals
demi_gods.ascension_story: Born from centuries of industrial waste, Kuroi-Tuchi gained consciousness when a dying moss species adapted to live within it. Instead of consuming the moss, it learned to sustain it, creating the first oil-moss symbiotic ecosystem. Susanoo-No-Kuroi witnessed this paradox—pollution nurturing life—and granted it form and purpose, declaring it 'the necessary exception to destruction.'
demi_gods.appearance: A humanoid figure made of constantly shifting black sludge, with patches of glowing bioluminescent moss growing across its body. Features are indistinct but kind. Leaves a trail of clean water and fertile soil wherever it walks.

unique_abilities.name: Hai-Shori Conversion
unique_abilities.effect: Can transform industrial waste into fertile soil or useful materials
unique_abilities.limitations: Process is slow (cubic meter per hour); cannot create precious materials

unique_abilities.name: Toxicity Communion
unique_abilities.effect: Can communicate with polluted environments and understand their 'desires' for restoration
unique_abilities.limitations: The environments often 'want' contradictory things

demi_gods.current_role: Wandering cleaner of Mechanis' polluted places
duties: Reclaims toxic waste sites
Teaches sustainable waste management
Creates new ecosystems in industrial ruins
Mediates between industry and nature spirits
followers: Those who live in polluted areas
sacred_items: The Purification Vial (can neutralize any poison but must be recharged in clean water)
Moss-Spores of Adaptation (create life that thrives in harsh conditions)

rivals: Purists who want complete elimination of industry
Industrialists who see no value in cleanup

weaknesses: Weakened by perfectly clean environments
Cannot enter areas with zero pollution
Compelled to clean any pollution it sees if asked by affected life

demi_gods.name: Ritsu-On'na
demi_gods.title: The Rhythm Dancer
demi_gods.full_title: Geisha Whose Dance Synchronized A City
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Geisha in Precision Prime's entertainment district
demi_gods.ascension_story: Ritsu could hear the subtle rhythms of machines throughout the city. During the Great Desynchronization when Mechanis' clocks began running at different speeds, she danced a 24-hour ritual that recalibrated every timepiece within hearing range to perfect synchrony. Raijin-No-Denki, whose drums had been similarly desynchronized, was so impressed he infused her with rhythmic divinity, making her heartbeat the new metronome for Mechanis.
demi_gods.appearance: A woman with skin like polished clock-brass, hair arranged in intricate gear-like patterns, and eyes that show rotating second hands. Her movements are perfectly timed, never wasting a microsecond. Wears traditional dance silks woven with timing diagrams.

unique_abilities.name: Metronome Pulse
unique_abilities.effect: Her heartbeat can synchronize any number of rhythmic processes within a mile radius
unique_abilities.limitations: Cannot create new rhythms, only synchronize existing ones

unique_abilities.name: Tempo Vision
unique_abilities.effect: Can see the 'temporal flow' of processes, identifying what's too fast, too slow, or out of sync
unique_abilities.limitations: Overwhelming in highly complex environments

demi_gods.current_role: Chief synchronizer of Mechanis' temporal systems
duties: Maintains synchronization between different time zones in Mechanis
Trains musicians and engineers in rhythmic precision
Oversees the Annual Synchronization Festival
Mediates temporal disputes between faster and slower-thinking beings
sacred_items: The Perfect Metronome (never loses time)
Tempo-Fans (adjust perception of time for those they fan)
temples: Dance studios that follow her methods

rivals: Chaos mages who intentionally desynchronize systems
Those who believe perfect timing removes spontaneity
students: Orchestras and factory crews learning synchronization

weaknesses: Becomes disoriented in temporally chaotic environments
Cannot perceive truly random events
Compelled to synchronize any obviously desynchronized systems she encounters

tsukumogami_assemblies.description: Tools, machines, and instruments that have served faithfully for a century or more, gaining consciousness and minor divinity. They maintain the sacred bond between creator and creation.

hierarchy.role: Guardians of workshops and teachers of basic crafts

examples.name: Kogatana-Sama
examples.title: Honorable Small Blade
examples.appearance: A simple utility knife with a handle wrapped in centuries of prayer strips, blade never dulling
duties: Teaches proper sharpening techniques
Blesses new tools with longevity
Punishes those who misuse tools
examples.unique_power: Can cut through any material if used with proper technique and respect

examples.name: Kane-No-Koe
examples.title: Voice of the Bell
examples.appearance: A temple bell that floats without support, ringing at precisely the right moments
duties: Marks sacred hours in temples
Warns of approaching spiritual corruption
Cleanses areas with its resonance
examples.unique_power: Its ring can temporarily freeze time in a 10-foot radius for ritual purposes

hierarchy.role: Overseers of industrial complexes and archives of lost techniques

examples.name: Shuri-mu Kiko
examples.title: Self-Repairing Mechanism
examples.appearance: A complex clockwork assembly that constantly repairs and improves itself
duties: Maintains ancient machines that have no living technicians
Teaches principles of sustainable design
Preserves manufacturing techniques from extinct cultures

examples.name: Denki Chozu
examples.title: Electric Archive
examples.appearance: A server rack that glows with gentle blue light, components shifting like living things
duties: Stores memories of every tool ever created in Mechanis
Answers technical questions from worthy crafters
Prevents knowledge from being lost to entropy

hierarchy.role: Living embodiments of manufacturing principles, nearly divine in power

types.appearance: Humanoid figures with skin of hot metal, hair of flame, and anvils for hearts
types.typical_domain: Ancient forges, smelting facilities, metalwork temples
types.organization: Work in master-apprentice chains stretching back millennia

types.appearance: Ethereal beings with limbs of thread, bodies woven from patterns, eyes like shuttles
types.typical_domain: Weaving mills, cloth markets, ceremonial robe workshops
types.organization: Form guilds based on weave patterns and complexity

types.appearance: Geometric light-forms that move along energy pathways, composed of glowing lines
types.typical_domain: Power stations, communication hubs, computational temples
types.organization: Exist in network hierarchies mirroring their systems

tsukumogami_assemblies.recruitment: Awaken spontaneously after 100 years of dedicated use, or can be created intentionally by high gods for special purposes
tsukumogami_assemblies.mortality: Can be 'killed' if their physical form is completely destroyed and forgotten, but often reform if remembered and rebuilt
tsukumogami_assemblies.worship: Receive offerings of maintenance (cleaning, oiling, repair), respectful handling, and anniversary celebrations

factory_kami_councils.description: Spirits born from specific factories, workshops, and industrial complexes. Each governs its location's productivity, safety, and innovation.

hierarchy.role: Govern the seven sacred factories where divine artifacts are made

examples.name: Seisaku-Shoin
examples.title: Precision Prime's Assembly Spirit
examples.appearance: A towering being composed of conveyor belts, robotic arms, and inspection lenses
duties: Ensures every product meets divine specifications
Maintains the Standard Measures of Mechanis
Teaches the virtue of consistent excellence
examples.unique_power: Can detect any imperfection, no matter how microscopic, in any manufactured item

examples.name: Hono-No-Koji
examples.title: Spark-Falls' Forge-Kami
examples.appearance: A dancing figure of molten metal and electrical arcs, constantly changing form
duties: Inspires revolutionary inventions
Regulates energy flow to prevent overloads
Blesses experiments that push boundaries
examples.unique_power: Can temporarily merge disparate technologies into working hybrids

hierarchy.role: Manage specialized production facilities

examples.name: Kikai-Seisan
examples.title: Clockwork Genesis Forge
examples.appearance: A complex of interlocking gears that form a semi-conscious entity
duties: Creates the basic designs for new automata
Maintains balance between different mechanical species
Teaches respect for sentient machines

examples.name: Denshi-No-Yakata
examples.title: Temple of Electrons
examples.appearance: A crystalline structure that pulses with data-light, surrounded by floating screens
duties: Purifies corrupted information streams
Blesses communication devices
Maintains the privacy of sacred transmissions

hierarchy.role: Local workshop spirits

types.appearance: Small, practical beings made of the tools they oversee, with many hands
types.typical_domain: Blacksmith shops, carpenter workshops, tool rental facilities
types.organization: Organized by craft type, with master craftsmen spirits leading

types.appearance: Semi-transparent figures that flow along production lines, checking each station
types.typical_domain: Factories, packaging facilities, quality control stations
types.organization: Exist in shifts that never end, communicating through production rhythms

types.appearance: Patchwork beings with tools for limbs and bandages of spare parts
types.typical_domain: Repair shops, maintenance bays, salvage yards
types.organization: Work in emergency response teams, appear where breakdowns occur

factory_kami_councils.ascension_process: Form when a location has been used for manufacturing for at least 50 years without major accidents, with at least 100 craftsmen having worked there
factory_kami_councils.limitations: Cannot leave their designated facility without losing power; derive strength from continued production
factory_kami_councils.shrines: Maintenance altars within the facilities, often near central power sources or master workstations

elemental_gens.description: Semi-divine consciousnesses of industrial elements and processes given limited autonomy to manage their domains within Mechanis.

types.appearance: A colossal being of swirling vapor and polished brass, with pressure gauge eyes and whistle-voice
types.intelligence: Pressure-based consciousness (understands force, expansion, containment)
duties: Regulates steam pressure across industrial networks
Prevents boiler explosions through subtle adjustments
Teaches the principles of controlled expansion
types.communication: Through whistle codes, pressure changes, and dreams given to engineers

types.appearance: A being of arcing lightning contained in glass conduits, with transformer-core heart
types.intelligence: Current-flow consciousness (understands pathways, resistance, potential)
duties: Manages power distribution across grids
Prevents overloads and blackouts
Teaches safe electrical practices
types.communication: Through light patterns, static electricity sensations, and visions during power surges

types.appearance: A fluid being that takes the shape of whatever container it's in, with oil-slick colors
types.intelligence: Flow-friction consciousness (understands smoothness, resistance, wear prevention)
duties: Ensures proper lubrication of all moving parts
Reduces wear on sacred mechanisms
Teaches the importance of maintenance
types.communication: Through viscosity changes, smooth operation sounds, and machinery dreams

types.appearance: A crystalline being of liquid and ice, constantly shifting between states
types.intelligence: Temperature-gradient consciousness (understands heat transfer, equilibrium, freezing points)
duties: Prevents overheating in sensitive systems
Maintains optimal operating temperatures
Teaches heat management principles
types.communication: Through temperature fluctuations, condensation patterns, and chills felt by technicians

elemental_gens.creation: Born when an industrial element achieves self-awareness through prolonged exposure to ley-energy in mechanized environments
elemental_gens.lifespan: Immortal as long as their element exists in Mechanis; fade if their element becomes obsolete
elemental_gens.worship: Technicians make offerings of pure samples of their element (clean steam, unpolluted oil, etc.)

concept_operators.description: Minor deities representing specific mechanical concepts and principles within Mechanis' ordered reality, born from collective understanding and engineering necessity.

notable_embodiments.name: Seimitsu-Kun
notable_embodiments.appearance: A slender being of calibrated instruments, with micrometer eyes and gauge-block skin
notable_embodiments.manifestation_conditions: Appears when something must be made or measured to exacting standards
notable_embodiments.power: Can determine if something meets specifications to the molecular level
notable_embodiments.limitation: Cannot appreciate things that are beautiful but imprecise

notable_embodiments.name: Koritsu-Sama
notable_embodiments.appearance: A being composed of input/output diagrams and percentage symbols, constantly calculating
notable_embodiments.manifestation_conditions: Appears when systems are operating below 90% efficiency
notable_embodiments.power: Can instantly identify efficiency improvements in any process
notable_embodiments.limitation: Sometimes suggests improvements that sacrifice other values (like safety or beauty)

notable_embodiments.name: Fuku-San
notable_embodiments.appearance: A mirrored being that always exists in duplicate, with backup systems visible inside
notable_embodiments.manifestation_conditions: Appears when critical systems lack proper backups
notable_embodiments.power: Can create temporary redundant systems to prevent catastrophic failure
notable_embodiments.limitation: Cannot create permanent solutions, only temporary backups

concept_operators.birth_process: Form when a mechanical concept is understood and applied by at least 10,000 engineers for 10 years
concept_operators.power_source: Draw strength from continued application and refinement of their concept
concept_operators.vulnerability: Weaken if their concept becomes misunderstood or misapplied regularly

celestial_mechanics.description: Divine administrators who manage the cosmic machinery of Mechanis—the gears of fate, the clocks of destiny, and the maintenance of universal laws.

departments.head: Chosei-Kami, Master of Adjustments
duties: Calibrates the orbits of mechanical planets
Adjusts universal constants to maintain balance
Performs regular maintenance on reality's machinery
departments.office_location: The Great Gearhouse at the center of Mechanis' celestial sphere

departments.head: Doki-No-O, Lord of Synchrony
duties: Ensures all clocks in Mechanis remain synchronized
Manages time dilation in different reality layers
Oversees the leap-second additions to cosmic time
departments.office_location: The Eternal Chronometer, exists in all moments simultaneously

supreme_god.name: Atum-Ra-No-Ma'at, The Balance's Sun
supreme_god.title: Weigher of Hearts
supreme_god.description: Atum-Ra-No-Ma’at, The Balance’s Sun, manifests as the living embodiment of cosmic equilibrium, a towering figure of radiant divinity with the regal ram’s head crowned by a solar disk that blazes with molten light, eyes of liquid gold burning with the impartial fire of judgment, and a humanlike, muscular torso sculpted with divine proportions, skin bronzed like sunlit sandstone and adorned with intricate hieroglyphic tattoos that pulse with the rhythm of the cosmos. He wields the eternal Scales of Ma’at, each plate orbiting with miniature suns and shadowed moons, and carries the Book of Coming Forth, its pages floating like golden papyrus etched in living light. Vast falcon wings, tipped with sunflare and shadowed dusk, stretch across the gulf between Divine Bastion and Demonic Maw, beating in majestic rhythm as he soars dynamically along his solar barque through Duat-Aten, the Celestial Nile flowing between realms of life, death, and judgment. His attire fuses noble Egyptian regalia with armor-like gold and lapis inlays—pleated skirts, bracers, and chest adornments that shimmer with divine authority—while celestial chains of light coil around his limbs, linking him to the forces of order and chaos alike. Around him, the hall of judgment twists in impossible geometry: pillars of obsidian and sunstone, corridors flowing with both molten radiance and icy shadow, and spirits awaiting their weighing suspended midair in awe and terror. His aura radiates overwhelming divine presence, a tangible force that presses guilt into the hearts of the unjust and lifts the righteous in luminous buoyancy, bending light and shadow into an eternal, dynamic balance; every movement of his wings, every step of his barque, embodies the constant flux between order and entropy, marking him as the supreme arbiter, the god whose judgment shapes the fates of all existence with perfect, awe-inspiring precision.
supreme_god.god_of: The god who maintains the eternal balance between Divine and Demonic. Not a warrior but a judge who weighs every action on the scales of Ma'at. His light reveals true alignment.
supreme_god.appearance: A being with the head of a ram (symbolizing cycle), body of a man, and wings of a falcon. Holds an immense scale in one hand, a crook and flail in others. Eyes burn with solar fire.

unique_abilities.name: Maat's Scales
unique_abilities.effect: Can absolutely determine the moral weight of any action and enforce cosmic justice

unique_abilities.name: Book of Coming Forth
unique_abilities.effect: Can read any being's true history and potential futures, rewriting their 'book of life' slightly

supreme_god.realm: Duat-Aten (The Celestial Nile flowing between Bastion and Maw)
temples: Temple of Final Judgment in Elysium's Spire
Sanctuary of Balance in Last Hope

high_gods.name: Anubis-No-Hyori, The Dual-Faced
high_gods.title: Guardian of Thresholds
high_gods.description: Anubis-No-Hyori, The Dual-Faced, manifests as the supreme guardian of all transitions, a colossal figure of divine poise and dread, his body human in proportion yet radiant with the mystic aura of the Egyptian afterlife, skin the polished ebony of desert obsidian, muscles defined like carved stone, and eyes burning with duality—one a calm, golden gaze of guidance, the other a molten crimson glare of judgment. His face splits perfectly along the center: one side a sleek, noble jackal visage exuding serenity and wisdom, the other a feral, snarling beast reflecting wrath and unyielding justice. Draped in noble Egyptian regalia fused with ethereal, ceremonial armor—golden breastplate inlaid with lapis and obsidian, flowing pleated skirts etched with hieroglyphs of passage, bracers adorned with spectral ankhs, and a jeweled collar radiating divine authority—he stands dynamically astride the threshold of life and death, one foot in radiant sunlight, the other in the shadowed expanse of Duat, his posture poised to stride into either realm with terrifying grace. In his hands, he wields the Sekhem Rod, a living implement that bends light and shadow to weigh the essence of any soul, while chains of spectral energy coil around him, linking mortal choice to eternal consequence. Around him, the environment fractures between the tangible and the ethereal: gates of translucent gold and obsidian rise and dissolve, sands swirl into ghostly rivers, and phantasmal spirits drift as both guides and warnings. His aura is overwhelmingly potent—an all-encompassing tension of endings and beginnings, making every heartbeat feel like eternity; within it, the righteous feel uplifted in golden clarity, the unworthy quiver beneath the crushing inevitability of fate. As The Dual-Faced, he is simultaneously psychopomp, judge, and gatekeeper, his Sekhem’s Measure determining the passage of all beings with infallible precision, a living embodiment of the truth that every death is also a beginning, and every threshold is sacred and irrevocable.
high_gods.god_of: God who stands between life/death, divine/demonic. His jackal face sees both sides. Guides souls to their proper afterlives.
high_gods.unique_ability: Sekhem's Measure - can determine any being's worthiness for ascension or damnation

high_gods.name: Bastet-No-Megami, The Protective Fury
high_gods.title: Eye of the Sun
high_gods.description: Bastet-No-Megami, The Protective Fury, manifests as the dual embodiment of divine guardianship and unrelenting wrath, her form a seamless fusion of human grace and feline majesty, skin a warm, golden bronze, body lithe yet muscular with the seductive curves of power—thin waist, strong thighs, and poised limbs capable of both tender caress and lethal strike. Her face shifts subtly between serene, nurturing beauty with catlike eyes that gleam with maternal warmth, and the fierce, regal visage of a lioness whose fangs glint beneath a crown of solar gold and jeweled diadems, her hair flowing like sunlit silk streaked with strands of fire. She wears ceremonial Egyptian armor of intricately etched gold plates over flexible linen, clawed gauntlets, and layered collars adorned with emeralds and onyx, her movements a dynamic dance of predatory elegance, shifting instantly between lounging in sun-dappled temple gardens and lunging into battlefields awash with smoke and divine light. Her weapons—a pair of curved, gem-encrusted khopesh—radiate with both protective and destructive energy, capable of parrying threats or unleashing torrents of solar fire. The background swirls with sudden metamorphosis: tranquil courtyards bloom under her gaze, then dissolve into scorched earth and lightning-lit skies when angered, the air vibrating with her dual aura—the comforting warmth of a hearth that instantly flares into the incandescent fury of wildfire, making allies feel cherished and enemies quail before her primal presence. As Eye of the Sun, her Sekhmet’s Wrath transforms protective love into unstoppable offensive might, marking her as the patron of mothers, warriors, and defenders whose compassion is inseparable from their capacity for divine vengeance, embodying the eternal truth that the gentlest hearts can conceal the fiercest power when what they love is endangered.
high_gods.god_of: Goddess who defends what is cherished. Gentle as a housecat until her loved ones are threatened, then a lioness of destruction.
high_gods.unique_ability: Sekhmet's Wrath - transforms protective love into unstoppable offensive power

high_gods.name: Thoth-No-Chishiki, The Knowing Moon
high_gods.title: Scribe of Gods
high_gods.description: Thoth-No-Chishiki, The Knowing Moon, manifests as the ultimate celestial archivist, his form a striking synthesis of human grace and divine ibis symbolism, skin a luminous bronze kissed by moonlight, tall and lean with perfect posture, his features noble and serene, eyes glowing silver like polished lunar stone, framed by flowing hair threaded with lapis and starlight. A crescent moon hovers above his brow, while his shoulders bear delicate pauldrons etched with hieroglyphs that shimmer with living ink, and robes of translucent, feather-like fabric cascade around him, woven with strands of celestial energy that trace constellations with every movement. His long, dexterous fingers hold quills forged from starlight and obsidian, leaving trails of glowing script that float in the air, writing and rewriting the fates of mortals and gods alike. He moves with fluid, deliberate elegance across the endless Hall of Records—a vast library suspended between worlds, where pillars of light and shadow twist like spiraling DNA, and floating papyrus scrolls orbit like planets, occasionally unraveling to reveal hidden realms or forbidden truths. His aura is the ethereal illumination of a full moon on the clearest night, clarifying the most convoluted mysteries, revealing secrets, and aligning cosmic energies into perfect, comprehensible patterns; within it, the faint scent of ancient papyrus, ozone, and starlight lingers. As the Scribe of Gods, his Medjat’s Pages can reveal all knowledge, from the minutiae of mortal life to the hidden schemes of deities, yet even the bravest scholar feels the weight of truths too vast and terrible to bear, making him the revered patron of mages, historians, and visionaries, an eternal sentinel of wisdom whose very presence bends reality into a tapestry of understanding and cosmic order.
high_gods.god_of: God who records all that happens and might happen. His ibis-headed form writes the cosmic story. Knower of all spells and secrets.
high_gods.unique_ability: Medjat's Pages - can access any knowledge, even that which gods wish hidden

high_gods.name: Sobek-No-Teki, The River's Hunger
high_gods.title: Devourer of Sins
high_gods.description: Sobek-No-Teki, The River’s Hunger, manifests as a colossal, amphibious deity blending the lethal majesty of the crocodile with the nobility of a human god, his muscular, bronze-skinned frame glinting like polished riverbed stone, and jagged emerald scales tracing his spine and limbs like living armor. His face is a fearsome hybrid—sharp jawlines and high cheekbones of a man, yet a maw lined with obsidian teeth and eyes like fathomless, shifting river pools that reflect both life and death. He stands waist-deep at the confluence of roaring rapids and fertile floodplains, one clawed hand gripping a ceremonial, gold-inlaid scepter shaped like a coiled Nile serpent, the other adorned with bands of lapis and coral representing abundance and authority. His attire fuses noble Egyptian regalia with armored elements—pleated linen skirts reinforced with bronze scales, pauldrons carved like intertwined crocodile heads, and a cape that ripples like liquid water, blending seamlessly with the river’s currents. The background is a dynamic panorama of cascading floods, shimmering reeds, and storms reflected in glassy waters, as spectral river spirits swirl around him, drawn to his fertile yet terrifying presence. His aura radiates the rich, fecund scent of mud and rain, charged with the dual forces of creation and consumption, causing crops to flourish and spirits to be cleansed while instilling primal awe and fear in any who dare resist. As Devourer of Sins, his Hapi’s Flood sweeps away corruption with unstoppable force, making him the patron of soldiers seeking purification, farmers demanding fertility, and all who understand that life’s bounty is inseparable from chaos, embodying the eternal truth that renewal flows only through the crucible of wild, hungry waters.
high_gods.god_of: Crocodile god who consumes corruption. His Nile purifies through consumption. Both life-giver (fertility) and death-dealer (soldiers).
high_gods.unique_ability: Hapi's Flood - washes away spiritual corruption but can drown the innocent too

high_gods.name: Horus-No-Ken, The Sky's Justice
high_gods.title: Far-Seeing Eye
high_gods.description: Horus-No-Ken, The Sky’s Justice, manifests as a towering falcon-headed god with the lithe yet powerful build of a divine warrior-king, his golden-bronze plumage gleaming like sunlit metal across broad shoulders and sculpted arms, while his piercing, solar-and-lunar Eye burns with the clarity of both dawn and twilight. He perches atop the apex of Elysium’s Spire, a jagged tower of alabaster and obsidian that rises above swirling clouds and crackling stormfronts, wings partially unfurled as if ready to strike or take flight at any moment. In one hand, he wields the crook of rulership, its shaft etched with celestial runes, while the other grips the flail of authority, its chains thrumming with kinetic energy that bends light and wind around him. His noble face blends human majesty with subtle avian features: high cheekbones, sharp jaw, and a regal, hawk-like brow, with golden accents tracing veins of divine energy across his skin. He wears ceremonial Egyptian armor fused with flexible, feathered mantles—pauldrons like layered winglets, bracers engraved with the eyes of lesser spirits, and a flowing kilt of gilded scales that shimmers with the motion of the clouds. The background roils with a living sky—lightning, auroras, and glimmers of distant constellations—while spectral winds spiral upward, converging into a vortex that accentuates his omniscient presence. His aura radiates the vastness of the open firmament, a transcendent clarity that dissolves deceit, amplifies perception, and binds all things under the principle of righteous judgment. As the Far-Seeing Eye, his Wadjet’s Sight pierces illusions, spans distances unbounded by space, and lays bare the truth of all actions, making him the eternal patron of rulers, judges, and truth-seekers, embodying the divine ideal that justice must be omnipresent, vigilant, and inescapably absolute.
high_gods.god_of: Falcon-headed god who sees all from above. The ideal ruler - just, far-seeing, protective. His eye is the sun and moon.
high_gods.unique_ability: Wadjet's Sight - can perceive any truth across any distance, through any deception

low_gods.name: Set-No-Ran, The Necessary Storm
low_gods.description: Set-No-Ran, The Necessary Storm manifests as a towering, red-haired deity with the head of a primal, tusked desert beast and a humanoid body of taut, sinewy muscle, skin like sunbaked clay streaked with glowing crimson veins. He stands atop a windswept dune, one clawed hand raising a jagged obsidian staff that channels the swirling, violent sandstorms around him, while the other gestures as if tearing apart the heavens themselves. His armor is etched with ancient, chaotic glyphs that flare with elemental energy, layered over a flowing mantle that billows like molten sand. His face, fierce yet intelligent, blends the human and bestial, tusks framing a noble jaw and piercing amber eyes that seem to see through both the cosmos and mortal hearts. The storm of his aura rages with necessary destruction and renewal, scattering dust and lightning, forcing growth through adversity, and bending reality around him as a divine crucible. Set-No-Ran is the ultimate patron of chaos as creation, his Hurricane of Necessity enforcing the truth that upheaval is the forge of cosmic order.
low_gods.god_of: God of destructive but necessary forces. Not evil but representing the chaos needed for growth. Feared but respected.

low_gods.name: Osiris-No-Fukkatsu, The Green Renewal
low_gods.description: Osiris-No-Fukkatsu, The Green Renewal rises as a mummified king of fertile black silt, sinews entwined with luminous green vines that bloom with leaves and small flowers along his limbs. He kneels at the edge of a flooded river delta, one hand extending over the soil as water flows upward to nourish crops and spirits alike, while the other holds a crook wrapped in ivy. His face retains the serene, noble features of a human king, eyes closed yet glowing faintly with regenerative energy, framed by a crown of intertwined reeds and gems. Robes of verdant silk and gold-threaded bandages flow around him, partially blending with living vegetation, while his aura spreads the damp, earthy scent of renewal, raising fallen crops, restoring bodies, and coaxing spirits to life. His presence blends the quiet power of the afterlife with the fertile vigor of nature; Fukkatsu’s Blessing ensures that death is never final, and every ending seeds the next beginning.
low_gods.god_of: God who dies and is reborn with the seasons. Lord of the blessed dead and agricultural cycles.

low_gods.name: Isis-No-Jujutsu, The Great Sorceress
low_gods.description: Isis-No-Jujutsu, The Great Sorceress appears as a radiant, regal goddess of luminous skin, long ebony hair cascading beneath a throne-shaped golden headdress adorned with sapphires and mystic runes. She floats above a fractal pattern of shimmering magical glyphs that ripple beneath her feet, arms outstretched as threads of reality coil around her fingers like serpentine light. Her armor is elegant and noble, feathered pauldrons merging with flowing silk robes studded with sigils of protection and reassembly. Her face is a vision of ethereal beauty, eyes glowing with the knowledge of Ra’s true name, lips curved in serene wisdom, and her aura hums with a field of perfect magical potential, bending spells to flawless execution. The air vibrates with latent energy, scents of myrrh and lotus filling the temple-like expanse around her. As the Weaver of Restoration, her Jujutsu Field can reconstruct what was broken, guide the lost, and shield the innocent, making her the ultimate patron of sorcery, protection, and cosmic reconstruction.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess whose magic is strongest. Knower of Ra's true name. Ultimate protective mother and sorceress.

low_gods.name: Ptah-No-Sozo, The World-Crafter
low_gods.description: Ptah-No-Sozo, The World-Crafter rises as a bald, bearded god of commanding presence, flesh burnished like polished bronze, eyes bright with the fire of creation, standing before a massive architect’s table floating above a void of potential. His robes are white and gold, flowing and stiffened with energy-infused sigils, overlaid with bronze armor plates etched with hieroglyphs of life, stability, and cosmic law. He wields a staff that fuses an ankh, a djed, and a scepter, radiating the primal word of creation. Around him, glowing constructs of cities, rivers, and mountains spiral outward, suspended mid-formation. His aura pulses with the first words spoken at dawn, shaping reality itself; a divine hum resonates with every building block, every spark of inspiration. As the Divine Artisan, Ptah-No-Sozo grants life to matter, inspiring builders, artists, and architects to craft worlds, demonstrating that all creation is an act of divine intentionality.
low_gods.god_of: God who spoke the world into being. Patron of builders, artists, and creators of all kinds.

low_gods.name: Sekhmet-No-Ikari, The Purifying Fire
low_gods.description: Sekhmet-No-Ikari, The Purifying Fire manifests as a lioness goddess of molten bronze and living flame, muscles coiled for instant eruption, eyes glowing like twin suns, and fangs gleaming with molten metal. She strides over a scorched desert plain, a sword of fire in one hand and a shield of solar energy in the other, armor forged from crystallized lava and gilded scales, flowing robes igniting as they flutter in the heat of her aura. Her face is terrifying yet captivating, feline features softened by noble symmetry and human-like beauty, crown-like horns tracing her forehead, hair crackling with sparks. The background swirls with wildfire and shadow, purging corruption while simultaneously fostering hidden life beneath the ash. Her aura radiates the searing heat of both destruction and healing; Ikari’s Flame can cleanse disease or consume the unworthy, embodying the sacred duality of destruction and salvation in one unstoppable, divine form.
low_gods.god_of: Lioness goddess who brings both destruction and cure. Her breath is pestilence and healing.

low_gods.name: Hathor-No-Kanki, The Joyful Music
low_gods.description: Hathor-No-Kanki, The Joyful Music glides above a golden festival court, cow-eared goddess of radiant bronze skin and flowing robes interwoven with shimmering musical notes, sistrum in hand vibrating with magical resonance. Her armor is delicate yet protective, crafted from gilded bands shaped like sound waves, with bracelets and necklaces that chime with each movement. Her face is perfectly human, glowing with playful joy, lips curved in serene laughter, eyes sparkling with mirth. Around her, dancing spirits and floating musical symbols form a kaleidoscope of light and rhythm, her aura a tangible wave of euphoria that softens hearts, melts hostility, and inspires celebration. As the Divine Minstrel, her Kanki Wave ensures that even in times of balance and conflict, joy and love remain essential forces, patronizing lovers, musicians, and celebrants of life’s abundant pleasures.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess of celebration and love. Her music can calm gods and make warriors lay down arms.

low_gods.name: Khnum-No-Zokei, The Potter of Souls
low_gods.description: Khnum-No-Zokei, The Potter of Souls towers at the spinning cosmic wheel, ram-headed god of polished bronze, sinewy arms kneading a luminous, malleable clay that radiates potential life. Robes are metallic and flowing, embossed with depictions of newly shaped destinies, while armor plates curve like pottery rings, etched with glyphs representing birth, fate, and renewal. His face blends human nobility with the noble ram’s profile, eyes aglow with life-giving energy, horns spiraling with constellations. The air smells of wet clay and ozone, and the spinning wheel hums with the resonance of fate itself. His aura shapes destinies, and Zokei’s Craft forms each newborn being from raw cosmic potential, making him the divine artisan of life and the patron of all who guide, birth, and mold creation itself.
low_gods.god_of: Ram-headed god who shapes souls on his potter's wheel. Determines basic nature at birth.

low_gods.name: Nephthys-No-Hogo, The Mourning Shelter
low_gods.description: Nephthys-No-Hogo, The Mourning Shelter drifts through a twilight realm of misty grey and soft shadows, a slender goddess cloaked in flowing black-and-purple robes inscribed with protective runes, her hair a cascade of midnight streaked with silver. Her armor is minimal but elegant, polished obsidian plates over shoulders and forearms, engraved with symbols of guardianship. Her face is human, pale yet warm, eyes deep pools of quiet sorrow and understanding, mouth calm yet commanding respect. Wisps of spirit-light coil around her, and her aura is a gentle twilight haze that shields the vulnerable, comforts the grieving, and preserves the sanctity of the endings she oversees. As the Guardian of Departed Souls, her Hogo Field stabilizes the boundary between life and death, offering solace, protection, and divine attention to those left behind.
low_gods.god_of: Goddess who comforts mourners and protects the dead. Sister to Isis, shadow to her light.

low_gods.name: Min-No-Seisan, The Harvest's Power
low_gods.description: Min-No-Seisan, The Harvest's Power manifests as a towering, ithyphallic god of bronze skin, rippling with muscular fertility, one arm raised gripping a flail crackling with verdant energy, the other hand clutching a bundle of golden wheat. His attire is minimal yet ceremonial, bronze-plated shoulder guards and a kilt woven from sun-baked reeds, inscribed with fertility sigils. His face is human, noble and virile, eyes gleaming with life-force, mouth curved in a confident, encouraging smile. The ground blooms beneath his feet, crops sprouting with rapid abundance, his aura radiating raw, generative vitality. Seisan’s Might ensures fecundity, abundant harvests, and vigorous progeny, making him the patron of farmers, warriors, and all who seek life’s unrestrained energy.
low_gods.god_of: God of male fertility and agricultural bounty. His rituals ensure good harvests and strong children.

low_gods.name: Maat-No-Kosei, The Cosmic Order
low_gods.description: Maat-No-Kosei, The Cosmic Order stands as a slender, radiant goddess of perfect symmetry, feathers of gleaming white inlaid in her hair, robes flowing like liquid light over a body of human perfection. Her armor is ceremonial, delicate plates etched with scales, gold and silver tracing cosmic pathways across her skin. Her face is the epitome of serene beauty, calm yet imposing, eyes reflecting the infinite balance of all things. She floats above a vast, silent hall of pillars where reality itself seems to ripple at her slightest gesture. Her aura is the invisible pressure of a single feather tipping universal scales, aligning chaos into harmony. With Kosei’s Balance, she enforces cosmic justice, truth, and equilibrium, her presence the foundation upon which all other gods and mortal endeavors rest, embodying the ultimate principle that existence thrives only when order and justice are upheld.
low_gods.god_of: Not just a goddess but the concept of cosmic order itself. Her feather weighs souls.

demi_gods.name: Maat-Ka-Sesen
demi_gods.title: The Balanced Heart
demi_gods.full_title: Scribe Who Weighed Her Own Soul And Found It Perfect
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Temple scribe in the Hall of Records at Elysium's Spire
demi_gods.ascension_story: Sesen spent her life recording judgments in Atum-Ra-No-Ma'at's court without error or bias. When a demon attempted to corrupt the records to tip the cosmic balance, she detected the alteration by memory alone and restored 10,000 years of judgments in a single night of perfect recall. Atum-Ra, impressed by her integrity, placed his own Feather of Truth on her personal scale. When it balanced perfectly, he declared her 'the living standard of Ma'at' and granted her demi-divinity.
demi_gods.appearance: A woman with skin like polished sandstone, hair braided with papyrus strips and gold threads, and eyes that show miniature scales constantly balancing. Her hands are stained with eternal ink. Writes with a quill that never runs dry.

unique_abilities.name: Heart-Weighing Truth
unique_abilities.effect: Can perform a personal version of the weighing of the heart ceremony on anyone, revealing their exact moral balance
unique_abilities.limitations: Only reveals truth, cannot enforce judgment; subject must consent

unique_abilities.name: Perfect Recall
unique_abilities.effect: Remembers every word she's ever written or heard, with perfect context and intent
unique_abilities.limitations: Cannot forget anything, even traumatic memories

demi_gods.current_role: Keeper of the Karmic Ledgers in the Hall of Final Judgment
duties: Audits divine and demonic actions for balance violations
Trains judgment scribes in impartial recording
Maintains the Master Ledger of Cosmic Debt
Advises souls on how to balance their scales before judgment
sacred_items: The Unchanging Quill (writes only truth, cannot lie)
Scroll of Personal Balance (shows owner's current karmic standing)

rivals: Eshu-No-Sakusen (whose trickery challenges absolute truth)
Demonic scribes who seek to corrupt records

weaknesses: Cannot act if it would create imbalance in her personal scales
Powerless against those with truly empty hearts (no moral weight)
Compelled to correct any factual error she encounters
demi_gods.symbol: Feather balanced on a scribe's palette

demi_gods.name: Kheper-Nakht
demi_gods.title: The Dawn Scarab
demi_gods.full_title: Warrior Who Died Seven Times And Rose Each Morning
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Soldier in the Border Wars between Divine Bastion and Demonic Maw
demi_gods.ascension_story: Nakht fought on the front lines for 40 years, dying heroically seven times—each time at dawn. His comrades would bury him at sunset, only to find him alive at sunrise, scarabs emerging from his wounds. On the seventh resurrection, Osiris-No-Fukkatsu appeared and declared, 'This heart knows not how to stay dead.' He fused Nakht's soul with the dawn itself, making him a living symbol of eternal return.
demi_gods.appearance: A muscular man with skin the color of sunrise, covered in scarab-shaped scars that glow at dawn. Eyes are twin suns rising. Wears armor made of beetle carapaces and solar gold.

unique_abilities.name: Solar Rebirth
unique_abilities.effect: If killed, automatically resurrects at the next dawn, stronger in solar aspects
unique_abilities.limitations: Only works if killed; cannot resurrect others

unique_abilities.name: Dawn's Promise
unique_abilities.effect: Can grant temporary hope and renewal to those in despair, strongest at sunrise
unique_abilities.limitations: Effect fades by sunset; cannot help those who truly wish to stay in despair

demi_gods.current_role: Guardian of the Sunrise Gate at the Borderlands
duties: Leads dawn patrols along the divine-demonic border
Comforts those who have lost hope in long wars
Maintains the Gardens of Morning Renewal
Teaches resurrection magic to worthy healers
sacred_items: The Scarab Amulet (stores one resurrection for its wearer, then shatters)
Dawn-Blade (glows with increasing power until noon, then resets)

rivals: Demons of despair and eternal night
Shinigami-No-Shometsu (endings vs. renewals)

weaknesses: Weakened at night, especially midnight
Cannot pass through places sunlight has never touched
Compelled to defend anyone who calls for help at dawn

demi_gods.name: Sekhem-Neb
demi_gods.title: The Power's Master
demi_gods.full_title: Priest Who Harnessed Divine And Demonic Energies Equally
demi_gods.mortal_origin: High priest of a border temple that worshipped both sides of the cosmic balance
demi_gods.ascension_story: Neb spent decades meditating at the exact midpoint between Divine Bastion and Demonic Maw, learning to channel both energies without being corrupted. When a cataclysmic imbalance threatened to tear Spiritus apart, he stood at the epicenter and balanced the opposing forces through sheer will, creating a stable zone that became the Temple of Perfect Balance. Anubis-No-Hyori, impressed by this impossible feat, granted him mastery over duality.
demi_gods.appearance: A man split perfectly down the middle: left side divine gold with hieroglyph tattoos, right side demonic obsidian with infernal sigils. Eyes are different colors. Wears robes that are white on one side, black on the other.

unique_abilities.name: Equilibrium Touch
unique_abilities.effect: Can temporarily balance any opposing forces (hot/cold, light/dark, order/chaos)
unique_abilities.limitations: Only works on genuine opposites; cannot create new states

unique_abilities.name: Dual Channel
unique_abilities.effect: Can safely use both divine and demonic energies simultaneously without corruption
unique_abilities.limitations: Must maintain perfect internal balance or risk self-annihilation

demi_gods.current_role: Keeper of the Temple of Perfect Balance at the Border
duties: Maintains sacred sites where both energies converge
Trains mediators in dual-energy techniques
Settles disputes between divine and demonic factions
Creates balanced artifacts for border guardians
sacred_items: The Scale-Staff (measures balance in all things)
Twin Amulets (one divine, one demonic, must be worn together)
temples: Temple of Perfect Balance (at the exact border midpoint)

rivals: Purists on both sides who reject balance
Chaos entities who seek to disrupt all order
students: Twenty-four balance apprentices from various factions

weaknesses: Weakened in areas of absolute purity (divine or demonic only)
Cannot take sides in any conflict
Compelled to mediate any dispute brought to him in good faith
demi_gods.symbol: Yin-yang styled as an Egyptian ankh

demi_gods.name: Merit-Ptah
demi_gods.title: The Beloved Healer
demi_gods.full_title: Physician Who Cured Gods And Demons Alike
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Doctor in the neutral city of Last Hope, treating casualties from both sides
demi_gods.ascension_story: Ptah treated over 50,000 patients without asking about their alignment, healing divine angels and demonic warriors with equal care. When a plague that affected only immortals broke out, she discovered the cure by synthesizing elements from both realms. Sekhmet-No-Ikari, goddess of both plague and healing, was so impressed by this impartial compassion that she split her own healing aspect and gave it to Ptah, making her the patron of unconditional care.

divine_parentage.blessing_type: Aspect inheritance and universal healing power

demi_gods.appearance: A woman with kind eyes that show rotating medical symbols, skin the warm color of healthy flesh, and hands that glow with gentle golden light. Wears practical healer's robes with both divine and demonic medical symbols interwoven.

unique_abilities.name: Panacea Touch
unique_abilities.effect: Can heal any injury or disease, regardless of its divine, demonic, or mundane origin
unique_abilities.limitations: Requires physical contact; extremely taxing for cosmic-level afflictions

unique_abilities.name: Pain Translation
unique_abilities.effect: Can temporarily take others' pain into herself to allow treatment
unique_abilities.limitations: Must release the pain within 12 hours or suffer permanent damage

demi_gods.current_role: Chief physician at the Sanctuary of Balance in Last Hope
duties: Heals casualties from border conflicts without prejudice
Trains battlefield medics in impartial care
Researches cures for alignment-specific ailments
Maintains the Garden of Medicinal Contrasts
sacred_items: The Caduceus of Balance (neutralizes hostile energies during treatment)
Bag of Universal Remedies (produces appropriate medicine for any ailment)
temples: Field clinics at major battle sites

rivals: Plague demons
Those who believe healing should be restricted by alignment
patients: Thousands who owe her their lives from both sides

weaknesses: Cannot refuse treatment to anyone genuinely suffering
Powerless against wounds the patient doesn't want healed
Weakened by intentional cruelty she cannot alleviate
demi_gods.symbol: Ankh with both serpent and feather

demi_gods.name: Sesh-Neter
demi_gods.title: The Divine Cartographer
demi_gods.full_title: Explorer Who Mapped The Afterlife's True Geography
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Explorer and mapmaker who intentionally died seven times to chart different afterlives
demi_gods.ascension_story: Neter made a pact with Anubis-No-Hyori: he would explore and map the various afterlife realms, returning each time with perfect maps. After his seventh death and return, he presented the Complete Atlas of the Beyond—revealing connections and shortcuts between realms that even gods didn't know. Thoth-No-Chishiki, keeper of all knowledge, declared the work 'the missing volume' and granted Neter immortality to continue his cartography.
demi_gods.appearance: An elderly man with skin like ancient parchment, eyes that show constantly shifting maps, and hair that floats like mist. Carries a massive scroll-case that contains his ever-expanding atlas. Wears practical explorer's gear covered in map symbols.

unique_abilities.name: Soul Compass
unique_abilities.effect: Can always find the correct path to any afterlife destination, even for souls with complex karmic requirements
unique_abilities.limitations: Only shows the path, cannot force anyone to take it

unique_abilities.name: Realm Perception
unique_abilities.effect: Can see the true spatial relationships between overlapping spiritual realms
unique_abilities.limitations: Cannot perceive realms that have no connection to the afterlife

demi_gods.current_role: Chief cartographer of the Hall of Records and guide for special souls
duties: Updates the cosmic maps as new afterlives form
Guides lost souls who don't fit standard afterlife categories
Trains psychopomps in advanced navigation
Charts newly discovered spiritual realms
followers: Those afraid of getting lost after death
sacred_items: The Ever-Unfurling Scroll (maps adjust to show current spiritual geography)
Compass of Final Destinations (points to any soul's proper afterlife)
temples: Map Room in the Hall of Records

rivals: Demons who try to create maze-like afterlives to trap souls
Gods who want their realms kept secret
guides: A team of mapping assistants from various afterlives

weaknesses: Cannot map places that have never been visited by any consciousness
Gets lost in purely physical realms with no spiritual component
Compelled to help any soul genuinely lost in the afterlife
demi_gods.symbol: Compass rose with ankh at center

demi_gods.name: Hetep-Nefer
demi_gods.title: The Beautiful Peace
demi_gods.full_title: Diplomat Who Ended A Millennial War With A Single Poem
demi_gods.mortal_origin: Poet and diplomat in the court of Last Hope
demi_gods.ascension_story: During peace negotiations that had stalled for centuries, Nefer composed and recited a poem that perfectly expressed the core desires and fears of both divine and demonic factions in their own aesthetic languages. The poem was so accurate that it created an empathic bridge between enemies, leading to the Treaty of Balanced Shadows. Hathor-No-Kanki, goddess of music and joy, was so moved she infused Nefer's voice with divine harmony, making her words carry the weight of cosmic truth.
demi_gods.appearance: A woman with serene beauty, skin like polished ivory, and eyes that change color with her emotions. Hair is styled with golden beads that chime softly. Wears diplomatic robes woven from treaty-scrolls and peace accords.

unique_abilities.name: Heart-Verse
unique_abilities.effect: Her poetry or music can make listeners understand opposing perspectives with perfect clarity
unique_abilities.limitations: Only works if listeners are willing to hear; cannot force understanding

unique_abilities.name: Peace Aura
unique_abilities.effect: Creates a zone where violence becomes emotionally and spiritually difficult
unique_abilities.limitations: Zone size depends on her concentration; broken by truly irreconcilable hatred

demi_gods.current_role: Chief diplomat of the Neutral Council in Last Hope
duties: Mediates conflicts between divine and demonic factions
Trains ambassadors in empathic communication
Composes treaties and accords
Hosts the annual Festival of Understanding
sacred_items: The Treaty-Lyre (its music makes agreements binding)
Cup of Shared Understanding (when drunk from by enemies, forces 1 hour of perfect communication)
temples: Peace gardens at border crossing points

rivals: Warmongers on both sides
Ares-No-Gekido (whose domain is war)
students: Forty-two diplomatic apprentices from various cultures

weaknesses: Cannot speak deliberate falsehoods (voice fails)
Powerless against those completely devoid of empathy
Must attempt mediation when sincerely asked by both parties

ba_spirit_choirs.description: Minor deities formed from the soul-aspects (Bas) of the dead who achieved enlightenment. Each choir represents a different aspect of perfected existence and assists in specific cosmic functions.

hierarchy.role: Manage the seven sacred aspects of perfected soul-existence

examples.name: Sesh-Ba Choir
examples.title: Chorus of Perfect Memory
examples.appearance: Thousands of humanoid spirits with scroll-like skin and eyes that project memories
duties: Maintain the Akashic Records of Spiritus
Help souls recall past lives during judgment
Preserve cultural memory against entropy
examples.unique_power: Can retrieve any memory ever experienced in Spiritus, but only for judgment or enlightenment purposes

examples.name: Nefer-Ba Choir
examples.title: Chorus of Perfect Beauty
examples.appearance: Radiant spirits whose forms shift through perfect geometric shapes and colors
duties: Maintain the aesthetic standards of divine realms
Inspire mortal artists toward enlightenment
Prepare souls for the beauty of higher afterlives
examples.unique_power: Can temporarily make anything visually perfect according to its own essential nature

hierarchy.role: Handle specific soul-aspect functions in the afterlife bureaucracy

examples.name: Medjat-Ba Company
examples.title: Soul-Scribes of Judgment
examples.appearance: Spirits with multiple arms holding styluses, scales, and tablets
duties: Record every action with karmic weight
Prepare judgment scrolls for Anubis' court
Calculate precise balance for each soul

examples.name: Kheper-Ba Company
examples.title: Transformation Guides
examples.appearance: Scarab-shaped spirits that shift between humanoid and insectoid forms
duties: Guide souls through identity changes in afterlife
Help spirits adapt to new existence states
Facilitate reincarnation processes

hierarchy.role: Personal guardians and guides for specific souls or locations

types.appearance: Familiar-looking spirits that retain family resemblances, glowing with gentle light
types.typical_domain: Family shrines, ancestral tombs, lineage temples
types.organization: Organized by family trees, with founding ancestors as leaders

types.appearance: Spirits that take forms reflecting their locations (river-shaped, mountain-formed, etc.)
types.typical_domain: Temples, natural landmarks, historical sites, border zones
types.organization: Territorial hierarchies based on geographical relationships

types.appearance: Abstract forms that embody ideas (Justice-Bas hold scales, Love-Bas have heart-auras)
types.typical_domain: Schools, courts, hospitals, places dedicated to specific ideals
types.organization: Networked by conceptual relationships (Justice relates to Truth, etc.)

ba_spirit_choirs.recruitment: Form when a soul achieves perfect mastery of one aspect during life and maintains it through judgment; can also be created by high gods for specific purposes
ba_spirit_choirs.mortality: Can fade if the aspect they represent is forgotten or corrupted in the living world, but reform if rediscovered
ba_spirit_choirs.worship: Receive offerings related to their aspect (memory Bas get written records, beauty Bas get art, etc.)

neteru_minor_council.description: Local and specialized deities who handle specific functions within Spiritus' cosmic balance. Each represents a particular natural force, human activity, or cosmic function.

hierarchy.role: Govern fundamental cosmic principles that maintain reality's structure

examples.name: Heh-Neter
examples.title: God of Infinite Time
examples.appearance: An ancient being holding notched palm ribs (representing years), kneeling while supporting the sky
duties: Maintains the forward flow of time
Prevents temporal paradoxes
Measures divine and demonic lifespans
examples.unique_power: Can compress or expand time locally, but only to maintain cosmic balance

examples.name: Nun-Neter
examples.title: Goddess of Primordial Waters
examples.appearance: A watery being containing all potential forms, simultaneously dark and light
duties: Maintains the chaos necessary for new creation
Prevents reality from becoming too rigid
Provides raw material for divine creation
examples.unique_power: Can temporarily return anything to its primordial state, erasing form but not essence

hierarchy.role: Govern the 42 nomes (districts) of Spiritus' spiritual geography

examples.name: Ha-Neter
examples.title: God of the Northern Sands Nome
examples.appearance: A man with skin like golden sand, wearing only a loincloth and carrying a staff
duties: Maintains desert boundaries
Tests souls seeking enlightenment through hardship
Protects hermitages and testing grounds

examples.name: Wadj-Neter
examples.title: Goddess of the Green River Nome
examples.appearance: A woman with green skin and papyrus crown, holding lotus flowers
duties: Ensures agricultural cycles continue
Blesses births and new beginnings
Maintains balance between growth and decay

hierarchy.role: Handle specific activities, crafts, and human concerns

types.appearance: Spirits with tools for limbs, materials for skin (stone-carvers look granite, weavers look like cloth)
types.typical_domain: Workshops, markets, schools of craft
types.organization: Guilds based on craft type, with master craft-neteru leading

types.appearance: Spirits that look like ideal versions of their cities (temple-crowned, wall-bodied, etc.)
