hierarchy.role: Handle specific aspects of ancestral guidance and protection

examples.name: Agbe-Ancestors
examples.title: Farmer Spirits Collective
examples.appearance: Spirits with bodies of fertile soil and growing plants, carrying ancestral farming tools
duties: Teach traditional farming methods
Protect family lands from spiritual corruption
Ensure proper crop rotation memory
Bless seeds saved from previous harvests

examples.name: Ogboni-Ancestors
examples.title: Council of Elder Judges
examples.appearance: Spirits wearing judicial regalia, with scales that weigh ancestral justice
duties: Maintain memory of all community agreements
Settle disputes according to traditional law
Enforce oaths sworn on ancestors' names
Protect sacred community spaces

hierarchy.role: Personal guardians and guides for specific families

types.appearance: Recognizable as recently deceased family members, glowing with gentle light, wearing traditional family garments
types.typical_domain: Family compounds, ancestral altars, gravesites
types.organization: Organized by family trees, with founding ancestors as ultimate authorities

types.appearance: Spirits that embody their professions (blacksmiths with metal limbs, weavers with thread bodies, etc.)
types.typical_domain: Workshops, markets, places of trade and craft
types.organization: Guild-based hierarchies with master ancestors leading

types.appearance: Spirits that merge with locations (river ancestors look watery, mountain ancestors look rocky, etc.)
types.typical_domain: Rivers, mountains, forests, villages, crossroads
types.organization: Territorial networks based on geographical relationships

egungun_ancestor_assemblies.recruitment: Become eligible after living an exemplary life, receiving proper burial rites, and being remembered and honored by living descendants for at least three generations
egungun_ancestor_assemblies.mortality: Fade if completely forgotten by the living, but can be revived if remembered and honored again
egungun_ancestor_assemblies.worship: Receive offerings at family altars, libations poured to ground, remembrance ceremonies, and naming children after them

ajogun_opposition_legions.description: Spiritual forces that work against human endeavors—not evil, but representing the necessary resistance that strengthens character and tests destiny.

hierarchy.role: Govern the fundamental oppositions that test human existence

examples.name: Iku-Ajala
examples.title: Death Who Waits
examples.appearance: A tall, serene figure with one side living flesh, one side skeletal, holding a measuring rod
duties: Ensures deaths occur at appointed times
Prevents unnatural life extension
Tests those who cheat death
Maintains the balance between life and death
examples.unique_power: Can see the exact thread of each life and when it should naturally end

examples.name: Arun-Tuturu
examples.title: Disease That Teaches
examples.appearance: A being covered in sores that bloom with medicinal plants, carrying a bag of germs and cures
duties: Tests community health and sanitation
Strengthens immune systems through exposure
Purges weak lines from populations
Forces medical innovation
examples.unique_power: Can create diseases that specifically test a community's values and cohesion

hierarchy.role: Handle specific types of opposition and testing

examples.name: Ofo-Aye
examples.title: Loss That Purifies
examples.appearance: A thin, constantly shifting spirit that passes through possessions, leaving only essential items
duties: Tests attachment to material goods
Forces innovation through scarcity
Reveals true priorities
Cleanses through loss

examples.name: Epe-Ala
examples.title: Curse That Corrects
duties: Enforces proper behavior through consequence
Carries out justified curses
Tests community justice systems
Maintains moral equilibrium

hierarchy.role: Personal testers and minor opposition spirits

types.appearance: Spirits that look like shadows of the people they test, with exaggerated flaws
types.typical_domain: Individual lives, personal crossroads, moments of decision
types.organization: Assigned by Orunmila based on individual destinies

types.appearance: Spirits that embody community problems (famine-testers look emaciated, conflict-testers look divided, etc.)
types.typical_domain: Villages, cities, organizations, families
types.organization: Deployed based on community karma and needs

types.appearance: Spirits that merge with natural forces (drought-testers look parched, storm-testers look turbulent, etc.)
types.typical_domain: Farms, trade routes, borderlands, wilderness
types.organization: Cyclical deployment based on natural and spiritual cycles

ajogun_opposition_legions.ascension_process: Created by Olodumare as necessary parts of creation, or formed from collective negative energy that needs structured expression
ajogun_opposition_legions.limitations: Cannot act beyond their assigned testing parameters; must withdraw when lesson is learned or destiny fulfilled
ajogun_opposition_legions.shrines: Small, respectful shrines at life's difficult places (hospital entrances, courts, border crossings)

abiku_spirit_circles.description: Spirits who cycle through repeated births and deaths, teaching lessons about attachment, impermanence, and the value of life.

types.appearance: Child spirits with old eyes, bodies that flicker between solid and spectral, wearing beads that mark their birth cycles
types.intelligence: Cyclical consciousness (understand repetition, pattern, gradual learning)
